headline: Strategy and delivery for the tough decisions.
lede: I help executives, boards, founders and investors in financial services and technology decide what to build, buy or sell, and then get it delivered. Working with Electric Mind lets me take a problem from concept to strategy to delivery, with mature partners who know how to do it.
intro: Most of my work starts with a question that has a lot of money, time or reputation attached to it. Should we bring this platform in-house or re-contract? Is this business worth more to us or to someone else? What would it actually take to ship this, and who do we need? I do the thinking, build the case, and stay to make it real.

I've spent nine years in payments, digital banking, embedded finance and venture-backed fintech, on both the operating and advisory sides. That gives me the forensic detail to get the numbers right and the judgment to know which numbers matter. And because I work with Electric Mind, a Toronto consulting and engineering firm, I can bring a full team of strategists, designers, engineers and data specialists to the table when the work calls for it.

services.title: Strategy and big problems
services.summary: The thinking before the money moves.
bullets: Market entry, product strategy and roadmaps
services.proof: Built the economic case for a global bank to move real-time peer-to-peer payments in-house, framing the modernize, re-contract and build options for executive decision.

services.title: Mergers, acquisitions and divestitures
services.summary: Buying, selling and integrating businesses and products.
bullets: Options assessments: grow, partner or sell
services.proof: Led the due-diligence workstream and oversaw the carve-out and sale of Central 1's Forge digital-banking business to Intellect Design. Earlier, led a nine-person team through the zero-defect post-merger integration of an acquired fintech product.

services.title: Ventures, startups and advisory
services.summary: For founders and investors building something new.
bullets: Product strategy, MVP scope and go-to-market
services.proof: Partnered with the CEO of Cut+Dry, a San Francisco B2B fintech, to raise more than US$25 million across two rounds, and returned in 2025 to advise on its Series B. Laid the product foundation for Atelio, FIS's embedded-finance platform.

services.title: Delivery
services.summary: I stay through delivery, not just the deck.
bullets: Pod-based delivery models and team design
services.proof: Designed the four-pod delivery model, bottom-up resourcing plan and governance for a global bank's payments program, and managed a 14-person team launching a Canadian bank's digital platform on time and on budget.

how.headline: From a conversation to a full program.
how.text: Engagements scale to the problem. Some need one person for two weeks, and some need a team for a year. I can do both.

steps.title: A conversation
steps.text: Thirty minutes, no charge. Tell me the problem and I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right person and what it would take.

steps.title: A focused engagement
steps.text: Two to eight weeks for a decision memo, a business case, a diligence read or an options assessment. One senior person, direct access, a clear answer.

steps.title: A program
steps.text: Months, not weeks, from strategy through delivery, with a team sized to the work. Design, engineering, data and change management alongside the strategy.

partner.name: Electric Mind
partner.headline: Working with Electric Mind
text: For larger work I draw on partnerships with firms like Electric Mind, a Toronto consulting and engineering firm I work with. Electric Mind describes itself as a forward-deployed AI firm: strategists, designers and engineers who take a problem from strategy through to systems running in production, with deep experience in financial services.

That lets me scale from one person to a full delivery team without changing the way we work together. A small engagement can grow into a complex one without a handoff, and a complex one can start with a single conversation.
partner._review: Service names are taken from electricmind.com's practice areas (Strategy / Design / Engineering) as of Oct 26 2026. Run the whole block by the Electric Mind lead before publishing.

work.text: Business case, target solution and program design to move Zelle real-time peer-to-peer payments from a vendor-hosted service in-house: economics against 10%+ annual transaction growth, gap analysis between requirements and solution design, a four-pod delivery model, and the governance and commercial scenarios behind the executive decision.

Payments-platform modernization business case and multi-year roadmap across e-Transfer, wires, AFTs, bill payments, cheques, fraud and AML. Earlier, assessed modernization, partnership and sale options for the Forge digital-banking business, built the roadmaps and management presentations, led due diligence and oversaw the carve-out and sale to Intellect Design.

Product foundation for Atelio, FIS's embedded-finance platform: client personas, prioritized fintech experiences, product vision, competitive analysis, MVP scope and go-to-market plans with Sales, Marketing and Support.

work.role: Chief of staff; product manager; strategic advisor
work.text: Joined a San Francisco B2B fintech pre-seed and scaled it through Series A: investor materials and models behind US$25M+ raised, on- and offshore engineering teams shipping a logistics and marketing platform moving US$1B+ in monthly GMV, org-wide KPIs and roadmap. Returned in 2025 to advise the CEO on the Series B.

Post-merger integration of an acquired fintech product for a tier-one technology provider with a zero-defect cut-over. API and microservice design for a new consumer-banking platform. a 14-person team launching a Canadian bank's digital platform on time and on budget.

cta.headline: Start with a conversation.
cta.text: Email me with a sentence or two about the problem. I read everything and reply within a couple of days.
